Name: AsianJellyfish's Mr.Qi Portraits
Author: AsianJellyfish
Description:
Hi there! So this is my first mod... I know it not match the 'Aesthetic' Stardew Valley has, but I'm still not  professional enough to make it match.
Hey! Maybe i will redo it next time i had an art block!

This mod come with:
3 Choice of Mr.Qi's appearance
2 Choice to enable or disable his glasses

Wait! I also have this information for you:
There are two .png file named "Mister Qi" and "MrQi". Why? Because there are my friends that don't complete the quest before meeting him...

How to use this mod:
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Potraiture[/url]﻿.
2. Go to the Portraiture's Portraits folder.
3. Make a folder, and don't forget to use my name on it!
4. Put my .png files there! Don't choose all of them!

Note:
I will update this mod okay? {AsianJellyfish}

Downloads.Description: Young Mr.Qi(?). Just make him look cuter... Does not include sprite because i can't even make it!
